theorems.name: Submission.tae_lipschitz_c1_approximation
theorems.statement: ∀ {n : ℕ} (f : Rn n → ℝ) (K : ℝ≥0), LipschitzWith K f → ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ g : Rn n → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 1 g ∧ volume ({x | f x ≠ g x} ∪ {x | fderiv ℝ f x ≠ fderiv ℝ g x}) < ENNReal.ofReal ε
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
